description:
SNP haplotypes of a gene across a diversity panel: accessions grouped by their SNP alleles in the gene
+-2 kb (MAF >= 0.02, <= 20% missing), each haplotype with size, number of alternative alleles, whether it is
reference-like and its accessions, plus the SNPs (position, alleles, frequency and, where the panel genome is
annotated, the coding effect: missense, synonymous, stop_gained, stop_lost, start_lost, splice_site, with the
amino-acid change). Each haplotype lists its protein-changing alleles. Panels: 'lentil_ldp' = lentil diversity panel, 324 accessions, exome capture, CDC Redberry v2 (= LIS lentil gene IDs; KnowPulse); 'lentil_activate' = lentil diversity panel + ACTIVATE lines, 521 accessions, CDC Greenstar (Lcu.1GRN IDs; KnowPulse); 'cicer_wild_279' = 279 wild (C. reticulatum, C. echinospermum; population-site names such as Bari1_002) and cultivated chickpea accessions, resequencing, CDC Frontier v1 (kabuli v1 Ca_ IDs; von Wettberg et al. 2018); 'faba_norfab' = NORFAB faba bean panel, 196 accessions shown as 'name, origin country (Core code)' from Skovbjerg et al. 2023 Supplementary File 1 where listed, SPET, Ensembl Hedin/2 v1 (Aarhus University); 'pea_gwas_135' = field pea GWAS panel, 135 accessions including Australian PBA varieties (e.g. PBA_TWILIGHT, PBA_GUNYAH, STURT), GBS, sparse (about 3,000 genes with haplotypes), Ensembl Cameor v1a Psat IDs (ENA PRJEB35147); 'bean_mdp_adp_712' = common bean Middle American, Andean and BASE diversity panels, 712 accessions, GBS imputed (BeanCAP, Moghaddam et al. 2016); 'bean_wu628' = 628 common bean landraces and breeding lines, whole-genome resequencing, imputed (Wu et al. 2020); both G19833 v1 = Ensembl phaseolus_vulgaris, Phvul.001G243800 IDs accepted..
gene: a chickpea kabuli v1 Ca_ ID (Ca_00001, wild Cicer panel), a lentil CDC Redberry v2 ID (Lcu.2RBY.1g000010), a CDC Greenstar ID (Lcu.1GRN.1g000010, for the LDP + ACTIVATE panel), a curated lentil symbol (e.g. LcFIE), an Ensembl faba bean v1 ID (Vfaba.Hedin2.R1.1g000010, NORFAB), or a common bean ID (Phvul.001G243800 or Ensembl PHAVU_001G243800g, bean panels). Matching genes in the other lentil assembly are tried too.
